subject: science
grouping_policy: Rule: independent subquestions (問) are separate requests; 問 sharing conditions, passages, experiments or figures stay together; the sub-items (1, 2, ...) inside one 問 are never split. Pages used whole when only one unit is on them. Groups defined from the problem pages only, without answer-key content.

corrections.note: Official problem correction (問題訂正): page 7, 大問2 問2 choice キ wording '水溶液は塩基性を示す' corrected to '水溶液はアルカリ性を示す'. Attached to every 大問2 unit because the runner attaches corrections by 大問 number; it only concerns 問2 (the 大問2 unit starting at 問1).

answer_format: Mark sheet. Most items: choose one katakana choice (ア-ウ ... ア-ケ) per 問 or per numbered sub-item; combination tables for multi-blank items (e.g. 大問2 問3 1 ①-③, 大問3 問1 2, 大問5 問1 1). Some items ask to choose two ('二つ選べ'): 大問2 問2, 大問2 問6 2, 大問4 問5 2, and 大問3 問2 2 (two individual numbers from 6-12 in figure 3). Numeric answers use digit boxes labeled in katakana: 'ア.イ N' (大問1 問8), 'ア.イ g/cm3' (大問2 問4 2), 'アイ %' (大問2 問6 1), 'アイウ m/s' (大問4 問3), '入射角 アイ °' and '屈折角 ウエ °' (大問4 問5 1). Cover instructions 9-11 explain digit boxes, rounding and one choice per answer field.
